duplicate_diagnostic.note: Same hyperparameters, trained/evaluated on a split of the RAW 11,055 rows (duplicates kept). Diagnostic only — shows how duplicates inflate scores; never used for selection.

zones.rule: low = largest threshold with validation phishing recall ≥ 98% (≤ 2% of phishing sites called Safe); high = smallest threshold with validation precision ≥ 98% (≥ 98% of 'Likely phishing' sites are phishing). Safe: p < low; Suspicious: low ≤ p < high; Likely phishing: p ≥ high.
